headline: Japan commits to ensuring public finance sustainability and BOJ independence
summary: Japan has committed to ensuring the sustainability of public finances and the independence of the Bank of Japan. The document did not provide details on the debt issuance plan for the next fiscal year.
why: Japan's government debt is among the largest in the developed world, and investors track fiscal commitments and central bank independence for bond and currency markets. The Bank of Japan sets monetary policy for the country.
original_headline: Japón se compromete a garantizar la sostenibilidad de las finanzas públicas y la independencia del BOJ
